# league:status

Orientation commands — the ones to reach for when you do not yet know
enough to ask a sharper question.

## When to use this skill

- "What's going on in my league?"
- "Give me a status check"
- "Am I authenticated?" / "Is my token working?"
- "Which leagues am I in?"

## How to run

```bash
# League snapshot: standings, roster state, pending items
python3 -m sleeper.cli status <username> --league "<league>"

# The full context bundle — the recommended input when feeding an LLM
python3 -m sleeper.cli context <username> --league "<league>"

# Identity and league list for a username
python3 -m sleeper.cli whoami <username>

# Does SLEEPER_TOKEN work? (auth-required commands need this)
python3 -m sleeper.cli auth-check
```

## Key context

- **`context` is the big one** — it bundles roster, standings, matchup and
  pending transactions into a single payload meant to be handed to a model.
  Prefer it over running four commands when the question is open-ended.
- **`auth-check` first when a write fails.** An expired `SLEEPER_TOKEN`
  surfaces as a confusing error from whatever command hit it; auth-check
  says so directly.
- Every read command here works **without** a token except those that touch
  pending transactions.
